description: This source file contains internal grain classes implementing stream lifecycle producer and consumer behaviors in Orleans. It defines methods for testing stream cleanup, deactivation, and stream becoming, utilizing Orleans runtime and stream provider interfaces.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleProducerInternalGrain
classes.description: An internal grain class for testing stream production lifecycle, including removal of producer and deactivation scenarios.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleConsumerInternalGrain
classes.description: An internal grain class for testing stream consumption lifecycle, including transitioning to a consumer state.

methods.name: TestInternalRemoveProducer
methods.description: Removes a producer from the stream, cleans up, and updates state.

methods.name: DoBadDeactivateNoClose
methods.description: Performs a deactivation without proper stream close, used for testing stream cleanup on deactivation.

methods.name: TestBecomeConsumerSlim
methods.description: Transforms the grain into a consumer for a specific stream, setting up observer and registration.
